name: Post-Activity Report
description: Report submitted to SDAO after an activity: event summary, attachments checklist and signatories.

fields.label: Name of the Event
fields.hint: Official title of the activity, as approved in the activity proposal.

fields.label: Date and time of the event
Venue
fields.hint: Used to write the summary (the 'where'). Room, building, or online platform.

fields.label: Summary/Highlights of the Event
fields.hint: One to three formal paragraphs in past tense covering what happened, where, when, and who took part (speakers, participants, number of attendees), plus key highlights and outcomes.

fields.label: Invitation
fields.hint: Photo or scan of the invitation letter(s) sent to speakers or guests.

fields.label: Program flow
fields.hint: Order of the program with times.

fields.label: Committee Members
fields.hint: Officers and members who handled the event and their roles.

fields.label: Publicity Materials
fields.hint: Pubmats, posters, or screenshots of social media posts.

fields.label: Pictures with short description or narration
fields.hint: Event photos, each with a one-sentence description of what is happening.

fields.label: Liquidation Form
fields.hint: Scan of the accomplished liquidation form and receipts, if the event had a budget.

fields.label: List of Attendance
fields.hint: Names of attendees. A photo of the signed attendance sheet can be transcribed.

fields.label: Evaluation
fields.hint: Summary of evaluation results: number of respondents, average ratings, notable comments, and recommendations.

signatories.dean: School Dean/Director or Head of the Unit
